pages.title: Beyond the First Circuit
pages.text: Movement: $(l:aura:travelers_bricks)Traveler's Bricks$(/l) and $(l:aura:rebounding_enigma)Rebounding Enigma$(/l). Fortified works, Miner, Looter, and Spawner extend powered networks. Nether and End rites transform nearby blocks and biome.

pages.title: Shattered Stone Ring
pages.text: Equip the ring within 3 blocks of an explosion center on each axis. Across the affected blast, it spares ores and other nonterrain blocks; grass, stone, regular, chiseled, and cut sandstone, sand, dirt, cobblestone, and gravel remain destructible. It does not protect its wearer from damage.

pages.title: Looter and Spawner
pages.text: A powered Looter draws one item from the dungeon chest table above itself after 100 work steps at 5,000 power each. A Spawner chooses a natural monster for the local biome and structure after 15 steps at 190 each.

pages.title: Miner's Charge
pages.text: Stored power feeds the Miner and its roaming singularity below. Watch its charge readout; after at least 21 charges, pulse redstone at the Miner to release ore. Greater charge yields more. If it goes 100 ticks without a charge, it expires.

pages.title: Contain the Miner
pages.text: Surround the Miner and the charge's path with Fortified Blocks before powering it; a failed enclosure causes a blast. In the Processor, pair End Stone with Dirt, Cobblestone, Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, or Dark Oak Planks, Glass, Obsidian, or Stone.

pages.title: World Rituals
pages.text: Feed stored power to a Nether or End Ritual. Each needs 100 work steps at 5,000 power per step; it remaps blocks and biome within about 150 blocks, then removes itself when its queue ends. The End rite leaves water unchanged. See $(l:aura:consumers_vortex)Vortex$(/l) for the Nether recipe.
